name: readable-layout-plain
description: Lays out the terminal transcript so it reads like a conversation: your messages and Claude's answers in labeled boxes, and Claude's work as quiet lines between them. Based on readable-layout by Garvit Nangru, without the bold-text recoloring or the end-of-turn rule.

boxes.title: Claude text to box
boxes.description: answers boxes replies of more than a line or two and shows one-line notes as quiet lines; all boxes everything Claude writes
